text:
ravi: Quick public kudos to @anya and @mike who rescued the snack stash and the office Wi-Fi during yesterday's chaos. You two are my heroes. :star: :wifi:
anya: glad we could help! found the router unplugged behind the credenza and three boxes of granola bars hiding under the conference table. :mag: :cookie:
mike: lol those granola bars staged an escape attempt. moved everything to labeled bins on the kitchen shelf. also rebooted the router — apologies for the flaky Zooms. :sweat_smile: :toolbox:
sophia: shoutout to @jules in support who rerouted the customer demo while we fixed the wifi. kept the calm in the storm. :clap: :telephone_receiver:
jules: happy to help! also leaving cookies in the kitchen under "kudos" label. help yourselves. :biscuit: :tada:
ops-bot: incident_log: NETWORK-293 resolved by mike at 21:14. notes: unplugged router + power strip overload. :robot_face:
ravi: tiny asks: if you grab snacks, leave a quick emoji so we can restock. and tag #facilities if you see unlabeled gear. cross-team wins deserve a public cheer. :raised_hands:
anya: agreed. will drop a short note to facilities with pictures of the bins for future reference. :camera:
mike: also, curious poll: which emergency snack should we keep in a 24/7 drawer? options: granola, trail mix, mini-cookies. vote with emoji. :ballot_box_with_check:
